description: DEV ONLY. Lets a locally served Duct app (Next dev server) call the shell commands from a built dev bundle, where localhost is a remote origin rather than a devUrl. Release builds must exclude this: tauri.conf.json pins app.security.capabilities to ["default"], and only tauri.dev.conf.json opts this back in. The port is wildcarded because URLPattern matching on an explicit port does not match reliably.
